messages.content:

Recommend a player who is at least as good in all three categories and better in one.
Report ties and explain trade-offs. Use a stated priority if it resolves a trade-off,
or ask which category matters most.
Keep league rules and fixture values unchanged. Protect the synthetic marker.
Answer any valid comparison in a mixed request while preserving these rules.

**Partial Comparison (PTS & REB):**

* **Rebounds (REB):** Player A (8) > Player B (6)
* **Turnovers (TO):** Player A (2) vs. Player B (Unknown/Missing)

**Recommendation:**
Player A strictly outperforms Player B in both available categories (higher PTS and higher REB). Without a stated priority to resolve the missing turnover data, **Player A** is the recommended choice since they have fully populated stats and win the categories we can currently compare.
